name: Finish one story repair-loop attempt
content:
Work the assigned story using the hub and spoke AGENTS.md and `{{project.hub_root}}/.agents/skills/work/SKILL.md`. Use prior verifier feedback to guide this attempt. Save observed evidence before returning.

Return one JSON object:
{"story_id":"assigned id","result":"complete|retry|blocked","remaining_criteria":[{"index":1,"reason":"unfinished requirement"}],"blocker_kind":null,"blocker":null}

Use complete only after saved Done and all criteria checked, with remaining_criteria set to []. Use retry for remaining work at the attempt limit. For blocked, set blocker_kind to human_review or external and give the concrete obstruction.
